newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait Insurance 1996 net profit up 65pct.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Insurance 1996 net profit up 65pct.

text.p: Kuwait Insurance Company reported on Monday a 65 percent rise in its 1996 net profit to 11.1 million dinars ($36.8 million).
A statement by the firm said: "These are the highest profits since the company's formation" in 1960.
The board of directors is proposing a 40 percent cash dividend and five bonus shares for each 100 shares. The proposed dividend distribution requires approval by the general assembly.
Kuwait Insurance shares have a face value of 100 fils. They closed on Monday at 730 fils, down from a year high of 790 fils on Sunday.
The company gave no further details.
